world_types.label: Ordinary world
world_types.description: Seas, plains, forests and mountains in their ordinary places.

world_types.label: Sand world
world_types.description: Dunes and dried seas under a merciless sun.

world_types.label: Lava world
world_types.description: Magma oceans, obsidian shores and ash plains.

world_types.label: Crystal world
world_types.description: Prisms, ringing hills and lakes of light.

world_types.label: Living planet
world_types.description: A world of flesh and bone that feels what walks on it.

world_types.label: Realm of the dead
world_types.description: Where souls descend; rivers of oblivion and pale meadows.

world_types.label: Dream realm
world_types.description: Floating islands and inverted valleys of sleep.

world_types.label: Mirror world
world_types.description: An inverted twin: what dies in one is born in the other.

world_types.label: Gas giant
world_types.description: Cloud bands, floating forests and an eye of storms.

world_types.label: Ringed world
world_types.description: A world crowned by rings of ice and stone that shadow its lands.

world_types.label: Asteroid belt
world_types.description: Countless drifting rocks bound by thin air and old tethers.

world_types.label: Tidally locked world
world_types.description: One face burns in endless day, the other freezes in endless night.

world_types.label: Void pocket
world_types.description: A bubble of land adrift in nothing, close to what lies outside.

world_types.label: The god's palace
world_types.description: Halls and gardens raised by a god's will rather than by nature.

world_types.label: Generation ship
world_types.description: A vessel the size of a world, carrying its peoples between stars.

world_types.label: Corpse-world
world_types.description: The body of a dead god, its lands grown over bone and old blood.
